description: Combined PRD evidence from two isolated Claude Code/Ralph stream worktrees. Verification and PR gate run on this integration branch.

userStories.title: Login endpoint rejects ambiguous JSON request bodies
userStories.description: POST /api/auth/login currently uses raw json.NewDecoder which silently accepts and ignores trailing JSON values after the first one and imposes no body-size cap. Harden it to use the shared httputil.ReadJSON helper so ambiguous or oversized request bodies are rejected with a clear validation error before any credential lookup happens.
acceptance: Given a POST /api/auth/login whose body contains two concatenated JSON objects, when the handler decodes the request, then it responds 400 InvalidLoginRequest without performing a user lookup.
Given a POST /api/auth/login whose body is larger than httputil.MaxBodySize, when the handler decodes the request, then it responds 400 InvalidLoginRequest without performing a user lookup.
Given a well-formed POST /api/auth/login, when the handler decodes the request, then existing happy path and unauthorized paths continue to behave identically.

userStories.title: Saved Browser Searches Show Active Indicator
userStories.description: After loading a saved Browser search the operator has no UI signal that says which entry was applied. As soon as the view drifts (search edit, filter change, facet toggle, sort, view-mode switch) there is also no way to learn that the current view no longer matches the saved definition. Surface an aria-current Active badge on the saved-searches row that maps to the most recently loaded definition, and clear that signal whenever the operator mutates any control that participates in the saved-search definition.
acceptance: Given a saved search is loaded, when the operator inspects the SavedSearchesPanel, then exactly that row has aria-current="true" and renders an operator-visible Active badge.
Given a saved search is active, when the operator clears the search input or types into it, then the active indicator is removed because the view has drifted from the saved definition.
Given a saved search is active, when the operator switches the Browser view mode via the toolbar, then the active indicator is removed because the view has drifted from the saved definition.
